claims: The 2026 Kentucky Derby is the 152nd running.
The 2026 Kentucky Derby is scheduled for Saturday, May 2, 2026.
The 2026 Kentucky Derby is at Churchill Downs in Louisville, KY.
Derby Week events start April 25 for the 2026 Kentucky Derby.
Commandment is trained by Brad Cox.
Commandment secured a spot in the 2026 Kentucky Derby by winning the Florida Derby.
Paladin is noted as an early 6-1 favorite for the 2026 Kentucky Derby.
Gates open at 9:00 a.m. ET for the 2026 Kentucky Derby.
The first race is at 11:00 a.m. ET for the 2026 Kentucky Derby.
The Kentucky Oaks is on May 1st for the 2026 Kentucky Derby.
Top contenders for the 2026 Kentucky Derby include Paladin, The Puma, Emerging Market, Fulleffort, and Pavlovian.
Official ticket packages including premium dining and hospitality are offered through Derby Experiences for the 2026 Kentucky Derby.
Ticket offerings include Club SI (first-floor paddock), Homestretch Club, and various Clubhouse/Grandstand seating for the 2026 Kentucky Derby.
Packages involving hotels like the Brown Hotel or Embassy Suites Lexington are available through Sports Traveler for the 2026 Kentucky Derby.
As of late March 2026, the field for the 2026 Kentucky Derby is taking shape through the final Championship Season of prep races.
100-point winners of prep races are guaranteed a spot in the 20-horse field of the 2026 Kentucky Derby.
